raw: I remember feeling sad when my father missed my school play. I’d saved a program for him, and I’d been looking forward to him being there and seeing me in it. His train was delayed by snow, so he couldn’t make it. I knew that wasn’t his fault, but I was still disappointed. I remember looking at the program I’d saved and thinking that giving it to him wasn’t the same as having him there. I’d wanted us to be able to talk about what he’d seen, not just have me tell him about it afterward.
